# ProtoCraft

> ProtoCraft is a Rust electronic design automation (EDA) desktop application and headless CLI for schematic capture, circuit simulation, PCB layout/routing, and manufacturing-file export.

ProtoCraft uses an original implementation and a native `.protocraft` project format. Its user interface and CLI support English and Brazilian Portuguese. Selected Proteus `.pdsprj` and `.dsn` projects can be imported experimentally; this importer is partial. STM32 and ESP32 catalog data supports physical device/footprint design, not firmware emulation.

## Source map

- `crates/eda-core`: project model, component definitions, commands, history, and geometry.
- `crates/eda-netlist`: electrical connectivity and ERC.
- `crates/eda-simulation`: native Rust DC/transient solvers, mixed-signal events, and SPICE export.
- `crates/eda-pcb`: PCB domain, manual routing, initial autorouter, DRC, and board exports.
- `crates/eda-storage`: versioned `.protocraft` persistence and manufacturing workflow.
- `crates/eda-library`: offline physical device and footprint catalog.
- `crates/eda-import`: experimental Proteus container, CDB/DSN parsing, and conversion.
- `crates/eda-i18n`: locale selection, translation catalogs, fallback, and JSON overlays.
- `crates/eda-app`: desktop application.
- `crates/eda-cli`: headless command-line application.

## Search vocabulary

Rust EDA, electronic design automation, circuit simulator, schematic capture, PCB design, PCB layout, PCB routing, PCB autorouter, Gerber RS-274X, Excellon drill files, SPICE netlist, STM32, ESP32, Proteus project importer, `.protocraft`, headless CLI, EDA em Rust, automação de circuitos eletrônicos, roteamento de PCB.
